CustomField.description: Count of items in this group whose Flag__c is Completed or Verified. Apex-maintained for the same reasons recorded on Items_Total__c. NOTE THE TWO-VALUE TEST: because Flag__c is the single lossy picklist the business chose, done means Completed OR Verified, and a rollup written against Completed alone silently undercounts every verified item.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Number of items in this group already completed or verified. Recalculated automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Items Complete
